raw_segments.text: Going down the path of Sycamore Street beside the Empire Musichal, Lenihan showed Emcoi how the whole thing was.
One of those manholes like a bloody gas pipe, and there was the poor devil stuck down in it, half choked with sewer gas.
Bookie's vest and all, with the rope round him. And be damned, but he got the rope round the poor devil and the two were hauled up.
